#news #police #arrest

On May 10, 2023. A Sheriff observed a blue Ford F150 that was travelling at a high rate of speed to an unknown house. When the vehicle pulled into the driveway. The Sheriff heard an unknown female yell moments later. The woman came to the Sheriff and advised that he wasn’t supposed to be there. When the sheriff spoke to him. He said he received a phone call from a man claiming he was having oral sex with his ex girlfriend, which is why he drove to her house. The man was identified as ”Nick”.
